description: Showing a handful of input/output pairs before the real input so the model copies their format and decisions.
Dozens to hundreds of examples in a long context. Can approach fine-tuning quality on narrow tasks, paid on every call unless cached.
Picking examples per request from a labeled pool, usually by similarity to the input, instead of sending a fixed set.
A vector representation of text where similar meanings point in similar directions. The fake model's `embed` is a deterministic bag-of-words stand-in.
The cosine of the angle between two vectors: 1 for the same direction, 0 for unrelated. The usual score for embedding similarity.
An example so similar to one already chosen that it adds tokens without adding information. Skipped above a similarity threshold.
The distribution of outputs among the selected examples. A one-sided selection pushes the model toward that label.
